run_zero_shot_classification: run zero-shot image classification evaluation on a MERU or CLIPBaseline model using prompt templates
run_linear_probe_classification: run linear probe classification evaluation by training logistic regression on frozen image encoder features
build_zero_shot_evaluator: build a ZeroShotClassificationEvaluator with dataset prompts and data directory for zero-shot evaluation
build_linear_probe_evaluator: build a LinearProbeClassificationEvaluator with a list of datasets for logistic regression probing
extract_image_features: extract image features and labels from a DataLoader using a model encode_image method
